overview.projectName: RoverNav — Autonomous Sonar Obstacle-Avoidance Robotic Vehicle
overview.summary: RoverNav is an educational two-wheel differential drive mobile robot platform designed to autonomously navigate cluttered indoor terrain using forward ultrasonic sonar scanning and high-torque DC gear motors.
overview.problemStatement: Introductory robotics students struggle with the complex integration gap between ultrasonic range finding, motor driver H-bridge PWM steering logic, and power isolation.
goals: Continuously sweep front obstacle distance using a servo-mounted ultrasonic sensor
Execute responsive differential steering maneuvers to avoid objects closer than 20cm
Provide independent high-current motor power rails protected against back-EMF spikes
scope: HC-SR04 ultrasonic rangefinder mounted on SG90 sweep micro-servo
L298N dual H-bridge motor driver with finned aluminum heatsink
Dual 1:48 TT DC gear motors with 65mm rubber tread drive wheels
Dual-deck smoked acrylic mobile chassis with front omni-directional caster ball
2x 18650 7.4V rechargeable battery pack with power rocker switch
Arduino Uno R3 central microcontroller with motor shield

features.name: Dynamic Sonar Distance Sweeping
features.description: Pans an ultrasonic sensor left-center-right using a micro-servo to calculate clear heading vectors.

features.name: Dual H-Bridge Differential Steering Control
features.description: Generates synchronized pulse-width modulation (PWM) signals to control left and right motor speed and direction.

features.name: Optical Wheel Odometry Tracking
features.description: Counts slotted wheel revolutions using infrared optical encoders to calculate vehicle travel distance.

features.name: Autonomous Obstacle Safe-Braking
features.description: Cuts motor drive immediately if an obstacle suddenly appears within critical 10cm emergency threshold.

roles.name: Robotics Student Developer
roles.description: Tunes navigation avoidance algorithms, tests obstacle thresholds, and monitors battery charge.

requirements.description: Ultrasonic sonar sensor shall detect obstacles within a range of 2cm to 300cm with 3mm accuracy.
acceptanceCriteria: Obstacle echo timing measured via hardware interrupt
Servo sweep cycle executes in under 400ms

requirements.description: Gear motors must provide sufficient torque to propel a 600g chassis up a 15-degree incline.
Motor driver circuit must incorporate flyback protection diodes to absorb inductive back-EMF spikes.
acceptanceCriteria: Zero reset glitches on MCU power line during sudden motor stops

teamRoles.responsibility: Schematic design, breadboard circuit assembly, component sourcing, and enclosure modeling
ESP32 C++/Arduino firmware, ADC filtering algorithms, and I2C display drivers

estimatedCost.basis: Prototyping components, breadboard, custom 3D printed enclosure, and 5V power adapter.
estimatedCost.disclaimer: Approximate estimate based on the supplied requirements.

resources.name: Electronics Prototyping Bench
resources.purpose: Soldering, breadboarding, and digital multimeter testing

hardware.workingPrinciple: Arduino Uno triggers 10us ultrasonic burst from HC-SR04; echo pulse duration calculates distance. If forward clearance is under 20cm, SG90 servo pans 60 degrees left and right to evaluate alternative paths, then drives the L298N H-bridge with PWM to execute an in-place pivot turn.

components.specification: Dual H-bridge, 2A peak per channel, 5V-35V motor voltage, onboard 5V regulator, flyback protection

components.name: HC-SR04 Ultrasonic Sonar Distance Sensor
components.purpose: Measures distance to front obstacles via 40kHz acoustic echo time-of-flight
components.specification: 2cm to 400cm range, 15 degree measurement angle, 5V operating voltage

roadmap.title: Phase 1: Drivetrain & Motor Controller Integration
roadmap.description: Mount TT gear motors on acrylic chassis and verify L298N bidirectional PWM speed control.
tasks: Mount DC gear motors, rubber wheels, and front caster ball
Wire L298N H-bridge to Arduino Uno PWM digital pins
Verify optical wheel encoder interrupts for odometry counting
completionCriteria: Rover executes forward, reverse, and spot-turn maneuvers under PWM control

roadmap.title: Phase 2: Sonar Radar Sweep & Obstacle Avoidance
roadmap.description: Mount HC-SR04 on SG90 servo turret and implement reactive navigation algorithm.
tasks: Mount ultrasonic sensor on servo pan-tilt bracket
Program collision distance threshold state machine with safety stop
completionCriteria: Rover autonomously navigates around obstacles without physical collisions

roadmap.title: Phase 3: Chassis Deck Stacking & Power Management
roadmap.description: Assemble upper smoked acrylic deck, 7.4V Li-ion pack, and run continuous navigation tests.
tasks: Fasten upper deck with brass standoffs and route wiring cleanly
Connect 2S 18650 battery holder with power switch and LM2596 buck
Perform 30-minute continuous obstacle avoidance navigation run
completionCriteria: Rover operates smoothly for 30+ minutes on obstacle course

assumptions.description: Rover operates primarily on indoor flat or low-pile carpeted terrain.
assumptions.reason: Differential dual-wheel drive with caster is optimized for smooth planar surfaces.

openQuestions.question: Is manual remote control override (Bluetooth / IR) required in addition to autonomous mode?
openQuestions.whyItMatters: Requires reserving hardware UART or timer pins for wireless receiver.

risks.title: Sensor Drift During Initial Heating
risks.mitigation: Include software lockout requiring 24 hours of burn-in heating before saving baseline calibration.

risks.title: Sensor Poisoning from Aerosols
risks.mitigation: Clearly label enclosure warnings against using silicone adhesives, hairspray, or VOC cleaners near unit.

recommendations.title: LiPo Battery Backup with Charger IC
recommendations.description: Consider adding a single-cell LiPo battery and TP4056 charging IC for 2-hour backup during power outages.
